items.title: Archer-Daniels Midland Vs. Bunge: These Two U.S. Agribusinesses Soar If the Trump-Xi Summit Yields Concessions
items.summary: A Trump-Xi summit could reshape global grain flows overnight, and two U.S. agribusiness giants are positioned very differently to capture the gains. Which one offers the better trade depends on whether you want torque or ballast.

items.title: Is Bunge (BG) Quietly Redefining Its Risk Profile With Extended US$8.8 Billion Credit Lines?
items.summary: Bunge Global SA recently extended three major unsecured revolving credit facilities totaling US$8.80 billion, pushing their maturities out by 12 months to between October 2027 and October 2031, which reshapes the company’s near- to medium-term funding profile. This longer-dated, committed liquidity from lenders underpins Bunge’s ability to finance working capital and large projects without near-term refinancing pressure, an important consideration for a capital-intensive agribusiness.
